ValidationRule.description: The Car Type field is required for the Needs Caregiver To Drive value in Vehicle field in the Driving Section
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( INCLUDES(Vehicle__c, "Needs Caregiver To Drive"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Car_Type__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide details when "Needs Caregiver To Drive" is selected for the Vehicle field in the Driving Section
